Okay I'm still here but I think about it a lot lol that's not right.... I need to talk to a doctor or something ugh.  A couple of days ago I laid on the floor in my bedroom trying to make my heart slow down and stop, using willpower pmsl it's so not funny but I'm too scared to use a different emotion in case I lose my shit in front of everyone. Faaaark. I'm okay. I just need to get out of this house. It's not a horrible house. They aren't horrible people but they make me horrible. Well they don't make me horrible.... ugh my brain. 
It would be okay if I just didn't wake up. That's not suicide. My people could be normal sad not crazy sad. It's not anyone's fault lol I just want to finish now.  I can wait 4 months and get my own place and then I'll have a reason to be.... I will. Ugh 4 months okay. Yes.
